title: MSigDF: Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB) in a Data Frame
text: Original data Broad Institute’s Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB)1, redistributed separate gmt data files MSigDB. gene sets contained MSigDB wide variety sources, relate variety species, mostly human. facilitate use MSigDB work, created pure mouse version MSigDB mapping sets mouse orthologs. pure human version also provided. Procedure: 1. current MSigDB v2025.1 gmt files downloaded Broad ftp.2. done human mouse gene sets3. collection converted list R, written RData file using save(). See script data-raw/ see data frames (tibbles) created.

title: MSigDF: Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB) in a Data Frame
text: three data frames (tibbles) package. msigdf.human data frame columns MSigDB collection divided sub-collection (like cc, bp mf C5). format data tidy, row single gene set collection, sub-collection gene symbol. msigdf.mouse data frame structure mouse orthologs. msigdf.urls data frame links name gene set URL Broad’s website. New C5 ontology information added category subcode easy filtering consistency. HPO: Human Phenotype Ontology MF: GO Molecular Function ontology BP: GO Biological Process ontology CC: GO Cellular Component ontology data sets package several million rows. package imports tibble package ’re displayed nicely. Take look: Just get entries KEGG non-homologous end joining pathway: software, e.g., fGSEA might require gene sets named list genes identifiers, name element list name pathway. data originally structured, can return plyr::dlply(). , let’s use hallmark sets, dlply data named list format, get just first pathways, , just display first gene symbols.

Human Collection gene sets https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/human/collections.jsp Mouse Collection gene sets https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/mouse/collections.jsp Get URL hallmark set fewest number genes (Notch signaling). Optionally, %>% browseURL open browser. Just look number genes KEGG pathway (sorted descending number genes pathway):

11 m2            all               197902 ## 12 m3            all               396685 ## 13 m5            all               885544 ## 14 m7            all                70547 ## 15 m8            all                47967 ## 16 mh            all                 7191 msigdf.mouse %>%   group_by(category_code,category_subcode) %>%    tally() ## # A tibble: 7 × 3 ## # Groups:   category_code [7] ##   category_code category_subcode      n ## 5 m7            all               70547 ## 6 m8            all               47967 ## 7 mh            all                7191 msigdf.human %>%   filter(category_code=="h") %>%   count(geneset) %>%   arrange(n) %>%   head(1) %>%   inner_join(msigdf.urls, by="geneset") %>%   pull(url) ##
